records: Liqwall's 14:02 UTC XRP derivatives panel is a single-provider snapshot. Open-interest contract coverage and aggregation are not fully reconciled against other providers; account ratios are not notional exposure.

October 29 ETF flow trackers use different universes: Alpha Finance reports 5-of-5 funds, CryptoETF.today only 2-of-5, and XRP Insights six spot funds plus BITW with GXRP excluded from flow due to a data gap. These totals must not be combined.

Binance's $6.3B estimated incident impact and approximately $3B frozen-asset figure are preliminary company statements. Frozen is not recovered; no XRP-specific replenishment amount or official membership of the five XRPL source wallets in the October 1 PoR set is established.
Binance Japan's cold-wallet separation statement is a company assertion, not an independent audit, and applies to the Japan entity rather than proving the status of Binance Global reserves.

Permission ASK circulating-supply estimates differ materially between CoinMarketCap (about 16.16B) and CoinGecko (about 23.107B). The issuer's documented supply API was not independently retrieved in this run; do not use either figure for market-cap or float inference until reconciled.

Permission's subscription-funded ASK buyback is an issuer-described mechanism; no transaction-level execution was verified. The Coinbase ASK wallet relationship does not imply Coinbase proprietary ASK holdings, an exchange listing, or XRP/XRPL integration.

The 65.9% GPT-3.5 and 60.6% GPT-4 SBIC values are two-author unanimous pairwise preference rates over gold explanations, not accuracy scores or general ChatGPT performance. They are unrelated to financial prediction quality.
The exact Camilla Stephenson YouTube identity remains unresolved; no exhaustive public-video inventory can be attributed safely to that exact identity.
Only GitHub access is verified in this environment. Claude, Grok, Gemini, Copilot, Codex, Hugging Face, Kaggle and Databricks have not been authenticated or tested as live collaborators.
